task: structured, reviewable VLM readings of complex figures: the thesis of Filatova (VKM-SRC-023, 64 image occurrences), the figures of the corpus pages flagged by the data hunt, and the images of two user intake documents
status_note: model readings are never VERIFIED and never observations; mine attribution only as printed in the image or caption; UNKNOWN/UNREADABLE kept; images, raw answers, parsed JSON, CSV and the review page stay in the git-ignored work directory; nothing written to evidence, the canon, PRIVATE, CORE or EDGE

code.package: benchmarks/figure_readings_v1/ (prompts_v1.json; scripts: extract_docx_images, render_vector, render_pdf_regions, read_figures, parse_readings, make_review, make_receipt, gpu_lock)
code.client: Qwen requests through benchmarks/chart_models_v1/scripts/run_models.py (request, VramSampler); GLM-OCR requests through vkm_corpus.ocr.client.request_body with the pipeline's DEFAULT_SAMPLING and table prompt, grey PNG as run_glm.grey_png

thesis.emf_rendering: vkm-libreoffice:24.2 (--network none) EMF -> PDF, pypdfium2 render of the drawing box (long side 3200 px)
thesis.caption_mapping: DrawingML/VML relationship -> media part; caption = the nearer of the first figure-caption paragraph below and the last table-caption paragraph above (each searched up to 6 paragraphs; a tie goes to the figure caption)

corpus.render: pypdfium2 at 200 dpi from the PRIVATE PDFs (sha256 checked against the register), boxes = corpus FIGURE/TABLE bboxes + 6 pt; two slides as whole pages

intake.INTAKE-A: confidential enterprise document (2 images; readings local only)

qwen.serving: benchmarks/chart_models_v1/serving/compose.yml profile qwen, own compose project, loopback port
qwen.sampling: temperature 0, top_p 1, seed 0, non-thinking, cache_prompt false; one retry of an answer that hit the cap: a loop with presence_penalty 1.0, a long answer with max_tokens 12288
qwen.prompt_rule: extraction prompt = class prompt + newline + COMMON_SUFFIX (prompts_v1.json); the hashes below equal the hashes recorded with every request

glm_ocr.serving: compose profile glm (internal network, socat proxy on loopback), own compose project
glm_ocr.sampling: pipeline DEFAULT_SAMPLING (temperature 0, top_p 1e-5, top_k 1, repetition_penalty 1.1, seed 0), max_tokens 6144 (pipeline table cap)

answers_at_cap.procedure: an answer that reaches max_tokens is asked once more: a greedy loop (a few lines repeating, or a runaway count 1, 2, 3 …) with presence_penalty, a long answer with a larger cap; a retry capped again is FAILED_REPETITION_LOOP or TRUNCATED_AT_CAP and is not parsed

tables.rule: strict: cells equal after NFC and whitespace collapsing only; tolerant: also equal when they differ only by look-alike Latin/Cyrillic letters, spacing or the decimal separator; rows aligned by dynamic programming on tolerant row similarity (gap 0.3), a column offset -2…2 per row pair; one-reader cells count as disagreements

wall_clock_local_2026_09_29.glm_server_start_to_healthy: 19:07:57 -> 19:11:15 (3 min 18 s, torch.compile and CUDA graphs)

gpu.lock: work/gpu.lock (owner QV) created before the first server, deleted after the last server stopped
gpu.note: peak_card_mib is the whole card (desktop included), sampled with nvidia-smi every 0.25 s during each request; the lock file was created atomically before the first server and deleted after the last one; main was told 'GPU released' at 19:12

deviations: 1 prompts: the first extraction pass (10 thesis images) was discarded after two greedy repetition loops; a common sentence (each entry once) was added to every extraction prompt and the caps of the non-table classes lowered to 3072; all 64 thesis images were re-read with the final prompts (the discarded answers stay in the local work dir)

2 retry of answers that reach the cap (not part of CH's decoding): a loop (<= 6 distinct lines among the last 40, or a constant-step count) is asked again with presence_penalty 1.0, a long answer with max_tokens 12288; the long-answer branch was added during the corpus run after dense mine plans produced complete but long lists; the four thesis retries were presence-penalty retries and all four are loops under the final detector

3 derived images read in addition to the originals (the original records stay): F023_024T (attribute-table strip of a GIS screenshot, cropped without scaling), F023_014a/b (the two panels of a figure whose whole reading looped twice), INTAKE-A:002R (a scan lying on its side, turned 90 degrees)
4 EMF/WMF: LibreOffice (container, no network) to PDF, then pypdfium2 render of the drawing box, instead of LibreOffice's PNG export (which renders the whole page at low resolution)

5 caption mapping: after the first run the rule became 'nearest of a figure caption below and a table caption above' (one table image had been given the figure caption three paragraphs below instead of its own table caption right above); images and model inputs unchanged (sent PNG hashes checked)

6 table comparison: rows first aligned by difflib on the first four cells; one misread key cell shifted whole blocks, so rows are now aligned by dynamic programming on tolerant row similarity with a column offset per row pair; the strict cell rule is unchanged and a tolerant rate is reported beside it

7 the model's own classification is kept for every image (no overrides): the stratigraphic column and the 22 x 22 correlation matrix of the thesis are TABLE_SCREENSHOT; the second reader (GLM-OCR) reads only TABLE_SCREENSHOT images
